props.name: addButton
props.comment: Replaces the default Add button; it is cloned with the add `onClick`.

props.name: children
props.comment: The inputs repeated in every row.

props.name: className
props.comment: Extra classes on the iterator root.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Hides every control (add, clear, remove, reorder).

props.name: disableRemove
props.comment:
Hides the remove button, and the clear button with it. A function decides
per row index.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.comment:
A label per row. `true` numbers the rows from 1; a function returns the
label for a row index; `false` renders none.

props.name: inline
props.comment: Lays a row's inputs out in one line from the `sm` breakpoint up.

props.name: removeButton
props.comment: Replaces the default remove button; it is cloned with the remove `onClick`.

props.name: reOrderButtons
props.comment: Replaces the default reorder buttons; it reads the row via `useIteratorItem`.
